nodes.name: NF pretreatment
nodes.procedure: NF was sectioned into 5×2 cm² fragments and subjected to sonication in an HCl solution for 30 min to eliminate the surface oxide layer. The NF was subsequently washed in sequential ethanol and acetone baths, each for 30 min, thoroughly washed with deionized water (DI) for 5 min, and then dried at 60°C.

nodes.name: Fe3O4/NF hydrothermal synthesis
nodes.procedure: 25mM of Fe(NO3)3·9H2O was thoroughly dissolved in 50 mL of DI water, with 0.5 g of urea added to the solution. The pre-treated NF was then immersed in this solution and transferred to a Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave, where it underwent a reaction at 150°C for 3 h and 30 min. After cooling to room temperature, the resulting Fe3O4/NF was washed three times with DI water, dried at 60°C for 4 h, and annealed at 200°C for 1 h.

nodes.name: Fe3O4@SrCO3/NF hydrothermal synthesis
nodes.procedure: A 25 mM solution of Fe(NO3)3·9H2O was prepared in 25 mL of DI water with 0.5 g of urea, while a separate 150 mM solution of SrCl2·6H2O was dissolved in another 25 mL of DI water. The two solutions were combined and stirred for 1 h before immersing the pre-treated NF into the mixture. In a Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave, this reaction was conducted at 150°C for 3 h and 30 min. Upon cooling to room temperature, the resultant Fe3O4@SrCO3/NF was recovered, washed three times with DI water, dried at 60°C for 4 h, and subsequently calcined at 200°C for 1 h.

nodes.name: IrO2/NF electrode fabrication
nodes.procedure: 20 mg of commercial IrO2 was combined with 70 μL of Nafion and 1,930 μL of ethanol to create a uniform dispersion. Then, 150 μL of this ink was uniformly applied onto a pre-cleaned NF piece with dimensions of 1×1 cm². The coated NF was air-dried, resulting in a catalyst loading of approximately 1.5 mg cm⁻².
